review.classification: deliberate discovery API break; one private canonical ledger, detached snapshots and generation-specific requester cancellation; other capability paths retained
review.semver: Owner-approved project version 1.3.0 for a breaking API release. Cargo caret compatibility differs; first-party RNS requirements select ~1.3.0. Package tiers unchanged.
review.deprecations: The actor::DiscoveryPathRequest import is retained, but public fields/Copy and the mutable actor map are removed. Exact approved removals have a public 1.3 migration guide; no blanket compatibility waiver.
review.wirePersistenceRuntimeImpact: No encoding, signatures, persisted formats, shared RPC, JNI, UI, AutoInterface ports or radio defaults change. Discovery deadlines, bounded coalescing and same-radio/Roaming/IPC response policy remain. Tokens cannot cancel other requesters, replacement channels, later operations or foreign actors. Last-owner retirement immediately removes related unadmitted bytes. Normal runtime lookup and recovery remain unchanged.
platformEvidence: Reviewed generated Apple ARM64 all-feature discovery delta: 32 unique additions, exactly three public field/map removals; cumulative floor diff +154/-3. Historical floor retained. Copy removal additionally protected by a compile-fail consumer.

Working-source focused gates: all 510 transport tests including one unrelated retained test passed; five new public-only private consumer tests passed; stable/MSRV transport all-target/all-feature strict lint and external fixtures passed.

Ratspeak, rsLXMF and rsLXST host workspace checks passed against 1.3.0; only RNS workspace versions/requirements changed in the manifest contract. Full clean-source, native and live interop receipts belong to the release handoff.
Exact final-source remote CI, Nix/source-consumer, signed packages and physical acceptance remain separate step-5-and-later gates. No hardware or fully green NomadNet claim.

September 24: one added provisional bind-readiness method, zero new removals; focused BLE/endpoint tests, strict host checks, and iOS/Android target checks pass; physical throughput remains unqualified.

bleThroughputReview.classification: Compatible additive provisional bind-readiness method; existing APIs retained. BLE implementation correction; no version, feature, MSRV, wire, or persistence change.
bleThroughputReview.ownership: Readiness retains the bind result without publishing ownership; cancellation before consumption still retires the unpublished generation.
bleThroughputReview.behavior: Bounded complete-packet Apple native queues preserve FIFO under backpressure, refuse whole new packets on overflow, use negotiated per-operation payload capacity and callback pacing, and isolate receive roles. Android unknown MTU falls back to 20 bytes.
bleThroughputReview.validation: Focused BLE/endpoint tests, encrypted Resource scheduling probes, strict host Clippy, and iOS/Android target checks. Hardware speed, PHY tuning, and role-selection optimizations remain separately qualified.
